steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case setup.
Confirm the Responses grid exposes the field-hiding control.
Open the list of fields that can be hidden.
Confirm GST is available as a field option to hide.
Hide the GST field from the Responses grid.
Verify that GST disappears from the Responses grid after being hidden.
